commentary_segments.text: All the capacitances which are present at the output terminals of one amplifier are sketched in this slide. The input capacitances of the next amplifier are included as well. The virtual grounds are taken as real grounds. An input voltage is added to measure the total capacitance at the outputs. It will be a differential input voltage to find the differential load capacitance, but a common-mode input voltage for the load capacitance of the CMFB amplifier.
